description: Send website conversion events to AppLovin from the server (its Conversion API): purchase, generate_lead, add_to_cart and the rest, up to 100 per batch, each with the visitor’s public IP, user agent and one identifier. Email and phone are hashed with AppLovin’s own normalisation before sending; a purchase dedupes on its transaction id. Needs the Conversion API key, which AppLovin enables per account on request; without it the answer says how to get it. Free.

events.description: 1–100 events; one invalid event makes AppLovin drop the whole batch, so all are checked first

data.description: currency, value, transaction_id, tax, shipping, items [{item_id, price, quantity}], search_term

dedupeId.description: same id the pixel sent for this event

name.description: page_view, view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase, generate_lead, sign_up, login, search, subscribe, add_payment_info, remove_from_cart, view_cart

userData.description: visitor identifiers used for matching; ip and userAgent are required

axwrt.description: AppLovin click parameter (axwrt), as captured on the landing page

clientId.description: client identifier captured by the pixel, if available

email.description: visitor email address; hashed before it is sent

os.description: device operating system: ios, android or desktop_os

userId.description: your own user id for the visitor

name: send_applovin_ads_events
title: Send conversion events to AppLovin
